# Code adapted from SillyTavern

SillyTavern is licensed under GNU AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/SillyTavern/SillyTavern/blob/release/LICENSE
Agent Arcade is AGPL-3.0 from 2026-11-13 and may adapt that code. AGPL-3.0 section 5 requires
modified files to carry notices stating that they were changed and when.

Each adapted file is listed here with the upstream revision, the upstream path, and what was
changed. A file in this directory also names its upstream path and revision in its header.

| Local file | Upstream path | Upstream revision | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `character-card-parser.cjs` | `src/character-card-parser.js` (`read`, `write`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. CommonJS; `parse` file helper dropped; png-chunks-extract / png-chunks-encode / png-chunk-text / crc replaced by a local chunk walker, tEXt codec and CRC-32; added size, signature, IHDR/IEND, chunk-length, tEXt CRC and decoded-JSON bounds; untouched chunks copied byte for byte; no console output. |
| `character-card.cjs` | `src/endpoints/characters.js` (`getCharaCardV2`, `convertToV2`, `readFromV2`, `charaFormatData`, `convertWorldInfoToCharacterBook`); `src/validator/TavernCardValidator.js`; `public/scripts/world-info.js` (`convertCharacterBook`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. One CommonJS module without lodash, Express, user directories, chat, avatar or world-info files; returns a frozen, bounded camelCase structure and truncates with warnings; lorebook entries carry the matching fields and, since the 2026-11-13 extension for `world-info.cjs`, the SillyTavern entry settings the activation engine uses as explicit bounded typed fields (placement, depth, role, selective logic, probability, inclusion group / override / weight, sticky / cooldown / delay, scan depth, whole-word matching, exclude / prevent / delay-until recursion, ignore-budget), written back into entry `extensions` on export; outlets, vector flags, automation ids, triggers, character filters and group scoring are not carried; `normalizeCharacterBook` and `toCharacterBookObject` expose the lorebook part on its own; card `extensions` kept as size-capped inert JSON, never interpreted; V2/V3 output omits SillyTavern private flat fields. |
| `macros.cjs` | `public/scripts/macros.js` (`evaluateMacros`, `getRandomReplaceMacro`, `getDiceRollMacro`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. One pure CommonJS function; only side-effect-free macros kept (names, card fields, date/time, newline, trim, noop, comments, random, roll, legacy `<USER>`/`<BOT>`/`<CHAR>`); variable, instruct, chat-state, input, pick, outlet, banned, timeDiff, datetimeformat, reverse and registered macros not ported; moment / droll / seedrandom replaced by Intl formatting, a small dice parser and an injectable random source; input, replacement-count, growth and argument-length bounds; linear scanning for trim and comments. |
| `world-info.cjs` | `public/scripts/world-info.js` (`checkWorldInfo`, `WorldInfoBuffer`, `WorldInfoTimedEffects`, `filterByInclusionGroups`, `filterGroupsByTimedEffects`, `parseRegexFromString`, `parseDecorators`, `getSortedEntries`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. One synchronous CommonJS function over normalized entries; no DOM, settings globals, events, extension prompts or files; timed effects kept in a serialisable state object with a turn-derived clock instead of chat metadata and content hashes; budgets in characters instead of tokens; regex keys screened (length, backreferences, nested or alternating repeated groups) and run under a per-test timeout, whole scan under a time budget; caps on entries, activations, scanned text, recursion loops and tracked effects; Author's Note and example-message positions mapped to at-depth / after with a warning, outlets dropped; group scoring, min activations, triggers, character / tag filters, per-entry match-persona / description flags, external activations and regex scripts not ported; three upstream inclusion-group defects not reproduced. |
| `regex-scripts.cjs` | `public/scripts/extensions/regex/engine.js` (`getRegexedString`, `runRegexScript`, `filterString`, `sanitizeRegexMacro`, `regex_placement`, `substitute_find_regex`); `public/scripts/extensions/regex/index.js` (script shape, `migrateSettings`, `onRegexImportFileChange`, `onRegexImportObjectChange`); `public/scripts/utils.js` (`regexFromString`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. Pure CommonJS functions over an explicit script list; no extension settings, global / scoped / preset stores or allow-lists, editor, debugger, slash commands or `characterOverride`; scripts normalized into frozen bounded objects with string placements, slash-command placement dropped with a warning; find patterns screened (length, unbalanced or nested repeated groups) and every match run under a per-script timeout and a shared time budget, a refused or timed-out script skipped with a warning; replacement assembled from collected matches, `$N` beyond the pattern's groups is empty; macros from the local `substituteMacros` subset, "escaped" mode escapes the macro values up front; caps on scripts, input, output and match count; regex cache not ported. |
| `group-chat.cjs` | `public/scripts/group-chats.js` (`group_activation_strategy`, `group_generation_mode`, strategy dispatch in `generateGroupWrapper`, `activateNaturalOrder`, `activateListOrder`, `activatePooledOrder`, `getGroupCharacterCardsLazy`); `public/scripts/utils.js` (`extractAllWords`, `shuffle`, `onlyUnique`) | `06bde939fb1e9c4c8d8641d810f0a916b5bce127` | Modified 2026-11-13. Pure CommonJS scheduling functions without chat, character globals, DOM, generation loop, saving, auto mode or swipe / continue / impersonate / quiet selection; members are library character ids; the turn is described by `lastMessage` and a short `history`; injectable random source consumed in upstream order; self-response ban by speaker id instead of display name; mention detection keeps the ASCII word rule and adds a substring match for Han / kana / Hangul name runs, ordered by position; manual strategy yields nobody unless a speaker is named (upstream `force_chid`, honoured for every strategy, muted members excluded); the two join modes become one that leaves muted members out; join prefix / suffix, `<FIELDNAME>` and chat-level scenario / example overrides not ported; only {{char}} / `<BOT>` / `<CHAR>` resolved inside joined fields; bounded names, members, scanned text, history and field lengths. |

The six files above are adapted from that revision (branch `release`); tests use synthetic
fixtures built in code. `safe-regex.cjs` is not SillyTavern code: it is the Agent Arcade pattern
screen and timeout guard that `world-info.cjs` and `regex-scripts.cjs` share for running
regular expressions taken from imported files. Character art, cards, lorebooks and presets published by the
SillyTavern community are not covered by the code license and are not bundled.
